title: Four independent five-field components with exact weight-indexed admission

claims.statement: The explicit product of four five-field degree-50 cyclic codes, with its fixed radius-13 adaptive list decoder, carries 1000 bits on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses with average block error at most 321897327624335963/500000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=69921595191736824424 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(65923/1000).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles (0), field, orbit count and primitive bound (1), exact weight-indexed child admission (2), and final weighted balance and occupancy (3).
